title: 九州新幹線~Kyushu Shinkansen
focus: 山地高速路線坡度牽引與在地防災~Mountain high speed grades traction and hazard response
summary: 以九州新幹線分期連接的歷史為背景，建立坡道、橋梁與城市車站交替的教學路線。學徒要比較爬坡功率和下坡制動的能量流向，並在地震、短時暴雨與設備停機時安排可驗證的降級營運。~Use the staged connection of the Kyushu Shinkansen to construct a teaching route alternating gradients, bridges and urban stops. Compare energy flow during climbing and downhill braking. Define verifiable degraded operation under an earthquake warning, short intense rainfall and equipment downtime, rather than treating rated traction power as evidence that every disrupted movement remains feasible.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 climbing=2377.944 kW；單元 2 得 traction=163.62 kN；單元 3 得 recovered=13.67708 kWh。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 mass 的擾動測試，結果改為 2615.738 kW；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以九州新幹線分期連接的歷史為背景，建立坡道、橋梁與城市車站交替的教學路線。學徒要比較爬坡功率和下坡制動的能量流向，並在地震、短時暴雨與設備停機時安排可驗證的降級營運。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives climbing=2377.944 kW; unit 2 gives traction=163.62 kN; unit 3 gives recovered=13.67708 kWh. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing mass in the first unit changes its result to 2615.738 kW. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the staged connection of the Kyushu Shinkansen to construct a teaching route alternating gradients, bridges and urban stops. Compare energy flow during climbing and downhill braking. Define verifiable degraded operation under an earthquake warning, short intense rainfall and equipment downtime, rather than treating rated traction power as evidence that every disrupted movement remains feasible. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2004 年：九州新幹線南側先行區間開始營運；2011 年：博多至新八代區間開通連接既有南段。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以九州新幹線分期連接的歷史為背景，建立坡道、橋梁與城市車站交替的教學路線。學徒要比較爬坡功率和下坡制動的能量流向，並在地震、短時暴雨與設備停機時安排可驗證的降級營運。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2004: The initial southern section of the Kyushu Shinkansen opened; 2011: The Hakata to Shin-Yatsushiro section opened and connected to the southern section. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the staged connection of the Kyushu Shinkansen to construct a teaching route alternating gradients, bridges and urban stops. Compare energy flow during climbing and downhill braking. Define verifiable degraded operation under an earthquake warning, short intense rainfall and equipment downtime, rather than treating rated traction power as evidence that every disrupted movement remains feasible. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率~Gradient resistance and climbing power
units.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率~Gradient resistance and climbing power
units.mechanism: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。 坡度以升高量除以水平距離表示，百分比與小數不可混用。此項只表示重力位能增加的速率，總牽引功率還要加上加速、滾動、氣動及轉換損失。 在同一坡道比較滿載與輕載的重力功率需求。~Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient. Multiplication by speed gives power, making faster climbing more demanding at equal force; descending requires continuous energy management rather than merely one stopping event. Gradient is rise divided by horizontal distance, so percentage and decimal representations must not be mixed. This term only gives the rate of gravitational potential-energy increase. Total traction demand also includes acceleration, rolling resistance, aerodynamics and conversion losses. Compare gravitational power demand for loaded and lightly loaded trains on one gradient.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 333300 kg，其餘固定，結果為 2615.738 kW。模型邊界：小坡度且定速；不含空阻、輪阻、加速與傳動損失。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 333300 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2615.738 kW. Model boundary: Small gradient and constant speed; aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, acceleration and drive losses are excluded.
units.verify: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 由高程剖面核對坡度，使用同一時間窗比對速度與牽引功率，另列非重力負載。~Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Check gradient from the elevation profile, compare speed and traction power over one time window, and list non-gravitational loads separately.
units.failure: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 功率不足時須分辨坡度阻力與黏著限制，不能只加大電流。~Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. When power is insufficient, distinguish gradient resistance from adhesion limits rather than only increasing current.
units.misconception: 長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動~One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
units.practice: 用相同高差設計長緩坡與短陡坡，對比理想位能和峰值功率，指出兩者為何不能用同一項設備額定值評估。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 climbing，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Design a long gentle and short steep climb with equal height gain, compare ideal energy and peak power, and explain why one equipment rating cannot evaluate both. Also recalculate climbing for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 黏著限制與可用牽引力~Adhesion limit and usable traction
units.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力~Adhesion limit and usable traction
units.mechanism: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。電機能提供更大扭矩不代表輪軌能傳遞；雨水、落葉與速度都會改變接觸狀態，使固定係數模型失去精度。 法向荷重應只取實際驅動接觸點的總量，不能自動使用整列重量。此上限也不描述黏著峰後的滑移控制；若輪重轉移，就要以每個接觸點重新分配。 檢查坡道起步時動輪荷重和接觸狀態能否傳遞要求牽引力。~Traction reaches the track through contact patches. A simple upper bound multiplies adhesion coefficient by normal force on driven wheels. More motor torque does not guarantee more transmitted force; rain, leaves and speed alter contact conditions and limit the accuracy of a fixed coefficient. Normal load must include only the driven contacts, not automatically the weight of the whole train. This bound does not describe slip control beyond the adhesion peak. Wheel-load transfer requires a new allocation across individual contact points. Check whether driven-wheel load and contact condition can transmit the requested force during a gradient start.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。敏感度：mu 單獨增加百分之十至 0.19998 1，其餘固定，結果為 179.982 kN。模型邊界：準靜態庫倫上限與均勻輪重；未建模蠕滑曲線及動態減載。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN. Sensitivity: mu, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.19998 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 179.982 kN. Model boundary: Quasi-static Coulomb bound with uniform wheel load; creep curves and dynamic unloading are not modelled.
units.verify: 比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。 以獨立地速校對輪周速度，核實輪徑設定，再按乾濕條件與軸荷分類比對。~Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean. Calibrate wheel-periphery speed against independent ground speed, verify wheel-diameter settings, and compare results by wetness condition and axle load.
units.failure: 只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 先查輪徑與地速誤差，避免把量測偏差當成真滑轉。~Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. Check diameter and ground-speed errors before interpreting measurement bias as actual wheel slip.
units.misconception: 電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著~A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
units.practice: 把黏著係數減半並比較動輪荷重調整，計算牽引上限，解釋為何撒砂或控制策略的效果需用試驗而不能只看馬達功率。 再以本單元 mu 的對照值重算 traction，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Halve adhesion and compare a change in driven-wheel load, calculate traction bounds, and explain why sanding or control performance requires tests rather than motor-power data alone. Also recalculate traction for the alternative mu value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.mechanism: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 把下坡能量回送與電網可接受時段對齊，另列剩餘摩擦熱。~Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings. The efficiency must cover a declared conversion chain. If it includes network receptivity, the observation window must be stated. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Align downhill regenerative export with receptive intervals and separately record remaining friction heat.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=242400 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.67708 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 266640 kg，其餘固定，結果為 15.04479 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=242400 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.67708 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 266640 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.04479 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded.
units.verify: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。~Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice.
units.failure: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。~Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together.
units.misconception: 只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網~Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
units.practice: 比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 煞車熱量與溫升~Brake heat and temperature rise
units.title: 煞車熱量與溫升~Brake heat and temperature rise
units.mechanism: 未回收的動能會在摩擦煞車與阻力路徑中轉成熱，平均溫升由分配到構件的能量除以熱容量決定。短時平均模型無法描述表面熱點、對流冷卻或熱裂紋，需要把能量分配與熱擴散分開。 有效受熱質量可以小於構件總質量，短時接觸表面的熱量也未必已傳到內部。能量平衡應先界定摩擦分配比例，再評估對流、輻射和間歇冷卻是否可忽略。 檢查連續下坡制動造成的累積熱負荷與冷卻間隔。~Unrecovered kinetic energy becomes heat through friction brakes and resistance paths. Average temperature rise is allocated energy divided by thermal capacity. A short-duration lumped model cannot describe surface hot spots, cooling or thermal cracks; energy allocation and thermal diffusion are separate questions. The effective heated mass can be smaller than total component mass, and short-duration surface heat may not reach the interior. First define frictional energy allocation, then assess whether convection, radiation and cooling between events can be neglected. Examine cumulative heat loading and cooling intervals during repeated downhill braking.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=1.212e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K)；計算：rise=energy/(mass*cp)=119.7628 K。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 1.3332e+07 J，其餘固定，結果為 131.7391 K。模型邊界：均勻溫度且無散熱、常數比熱；不推定摩擦材極限。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=1.212e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K); calculation: rise=energy/(mass*cp)=119.7628 K. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1.3332e+07 J, with all other inputs fixed, gives 131.7391 K. Model boundary: Uniform temperature without heat loss and with constant heat capacity; no friction-material limit is inferred.
units.verify: 以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。 在不同深度保留溫度曲線並核對感測器反應時間，用初末能量平衡檢查平均溫升。~Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity. Retain temperature histories at different depths, verify sensor response time, and use initial-to-final energy balance to check mean temperature rise.
units.failure: 局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 若表面與內部溫差很大，集中熱容量假設便不足。~Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. A large surface-to-core temperature difference indicates that the lumped thermal-capacity assumption is insufficient.
units.misconception: 煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點~A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
units.practice: 將同一能量分給兩種有效熱容量，計算平均溫升後設計能辨認熱點的量測網格，說明集中參數模型缺少哪些資訊。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Allocate equal energy to two effective thermal capacities, calculate average rise, and design a measurement grid for hot spots while identifying information missing from the lumped model. Also recalculate rise for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度~Cant and unbalanced acceleration
units.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度~Cant and unbalanced acceleration
units.mechanism: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。 殘餘加速度的正負表示側向作用方向，而不是安全與危險的二元判斷。半徑、軌距與高差必須使用一致長度單位，車體感受還會受到懸吊轉角影響。 在山地曲線比較通過速度與超高過剩的低速情境。~On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed. A slower service can experience cant excess, so increasing cant does not improve every train condition. The sign of residual acceleration identifies its lateral direction, not a binary safe-unsafe outcome. Radius, gauge and rail-level difference require consistent length units. Carbody response is additionally affected by suspension rotation, which this geometric estimate does not resolve. Compare running speed with low-speed cant excess on a mountain curve.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=60.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.13329 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 66.66 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.3260889 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=60.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.13329 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 66.66 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.3260889 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded.
units.verify: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。~Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor.
units.failure: 只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 需核對高差符號與曲線方向，防止左右軌互換。~Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. Check cant sign against curve direction to prevent swapping the inner and outer rails.
units.misconception: 任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度~Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
units.practice: 選兩種速度共同計算殘餘加速度，找出符號反轉位置，說明為何混合服務需要速度分布而非單一最高速度。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate residual acceleration for two speeds, locate its sign reversal, and explain why mixed services require a speed distribution rather than one maximum speed. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 地震偵測提前量~Seismic detection lead time
units.title: 地震偵測提前量~Seismic detection lead time
units.mechanism: 地震警報的可用提前量來自較快波到達感測點與較慢強震波到達設施之間的差，再扣掉傳輸和判定延遲。距離太近時提前量可能為負，警報並不能讓列車瞬間停止。 此處以相同距離比較兩種波速，屬簡化幾何模型。實際感測站可能不在線路與震源之間；可用時間還包括資料品質檢查及保護命令發送，不能只比較波速。 把震源距離和通訊延遲作為獨立變數，辨識預警限制。~Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay. A nearby source may leave negative lead time. An alarm therefore cannot make a moving train stop instantaneously, even when the detection itself works correctly. The exercise compares two wave speeds over the same distance and therefore uses simplified geometry. A real sensor may not lie between the source and railway. Available time also includes data-quality checks and protection-command delivery, not only wave propagation. Treat source distance and communication delay as separate variables when identifying warning limits.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：distance=101000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s；計算：lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=10.02381 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 111100 m，其餘固定，結果為 11.22619 s。模型邊界：共線源站幾何與固定波速；不預測震度或實際地震動。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: distance=101000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s; calculation: lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=10.02381 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 111100 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 11.22619 s. Model boundary: Collinear source-station geometry and constant wave speeds; neither intensity nor actual ground motion is predicted.
units.verify: 用歷史或合成波形重播整條訊號鏈，記錄偵測、判定、通訊及列車接收時間，量出漏警、誤警和延遲分布。 以完整訊號重播核對每個時間戳，將總延遲分解成判定、網路與列車端處理。~Replay historical or synthetic waveforms through the complete chain, log detection, decision, communication and train receipt times, and measure missed alarms, false alarms and latency distribution. Use full-chain signal replay to verify every timestamp and separate total delay into decision, network and train-side processing components.
units.failure: 只驗證感測器觸發而不驗證下游通訊，可能高估提前量；設備共用電源也可能讓兩條名義獨立通道同時失效。 感測成功不等於制動成功，須查列車收到命令後的動作。~Testing the sensor without downstream communication overestimates lead time; a shared power supply can also defeat nominally independent channels simultaneously. Successful detection is not successful braking; inspect the train response after command receipt.
units.misconception: 地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下~A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking.
units.practice: 將震源距離縮短並把通訊延遲加倍，計算剩餘提前量；與制動時間比較，提出只在模型範圍內成立的結論。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 lead，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Shorten source distance and double communication delay, calculate remaining lead time, and compare it with braking time without extending the conclusion beyond the model. Also recalculate lead for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度~Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
units.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度~Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
units.mechanism: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。 跨長四次方使幾何誤差特別重要，但只有在相同支承、均布荷載及截面條件下才可比較。將毫米轉成公尺後再核對剛度，可避免把量測位移誤差變成材料性能判斷。 量測橋跨與支點位移，避免把支承移動當成梁剛度改變。~For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending. A railway bridge also requires dynamic and track-interaction checks; this static beam exercise only reveals parameter magnitudes. Fourth-power span dependence makes geometry important, but comparison requires the same support, uniform-load and section assumptions. Convert millimetres and metres consistently before checking stiffness, so a displacement-unit error does not become a false conclusion about material properties. Measure span and support motion to avoid mistaking support displacement for a stiffness change.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=25.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=0.9451403 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 27.775 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.38378 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=25.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=0.9451403 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 27.775 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.38378 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis.
units.verify: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 先以已知荷載校對位移計量程與零點，分別記錄載入卸載路徑及支點運動。~Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. Check displacement-sensor range and zero under known loading, recording loading and unloading paths separately from support movement.
units.failure: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 若卸載後仍有位移，須區分基座滑移與構件殘留變形。~Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Residual displacement after unloading requires distinguishing fixture slip from permanent structural deformation.
units.misconception: 橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成~Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
units.practice: 保持截面不變增加跨長，再比較提高慣性矩的補償幅度，說明靜態位移符合預期為何仍不能取代動態驗證。 再以本單元 L 的對照值重算 deflection，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase span while keeping the section fixed, calculate the compensating inertia change, and explain why agreement in static deflection cannot replace dynamic verification. Also recalculate deflection for the alternative L value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.title: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.mechanism: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 以坡面集水和站口集水不同面積建立入流量比較。~A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Compare inflow from a hillside catchment and a station entrance using their different areas.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.02e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.30906 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.222e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.339966 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.02e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.30906 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.222e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.339966 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.
units.verify: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。~Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation.
units.failure: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。~Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating.
units.misconception: 排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位~A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
units.practice: 將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.title: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.mechanism: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 在爬坡高電流時估算供電壓降並核對回路定義。~Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. Fixed current is a simplification: a constant-power load can draw more current as voltage falls and thereby increase the drop. Estimate voltage drop during high-current climbing and verify the defined electrical loop.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=90.9 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1666.5 A，其餘固定，結果為 99.99 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=90.9 V. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1666.5 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 99.99 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。 同步量測供電端與受電端電壓及回路電流，核對接線極性和設備接頭的額外壓降。~Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes. Measure supply voltage, receiving voltage and loop current synchronously, checking polarity and extra voltage drops across equipment connections.
units.failure: 高阻接頭可能在總壓降看似可接受時局部過熱；把導體長度和回流路徑計算一半會系統性低估損耗。 需核對回流路徑，否則可能把接頭故障藏在錯估電阻中。~A high-resistance joint may overheat while total drop looks modest; omitting part of the return path systematically understates resistance and losses. Verify the return path so a faulty connection is not hidden inside an incorrect resistance estimate.
units.misconception: 量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常~Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
units.practice: 加入第二列同時加速的列車，畫出共享與非共享饋線段，分段重算壓降並說明何時需改用完整潮流分析。 再以本單元 current 的對照值重算 drop，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a second accelerating train, distinguish shared and separate feeder sections, recalculate each drop, and explain when a complete load-flow analysis becomes necessary. Also recalculate drop for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.title: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.mechanism: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 對設備停機建立修復時間分布，分析單一平均值的限制。~In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Build a repair-duration distribution and examine the limits of representing downtime with one mean.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1333.2 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9970087 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1333.2 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970087 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.
units.verify: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。~Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.
units.failure: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。~Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.
units.misconception: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低~High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
units.practice: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
